variants.title: 01 · 工装街头
variants.style: Outfit: oversized washed-charcoal cropped bomber jacket with voluminous sleeves, an ivory heavyweight T-shirt with a small acid-yellow hem layer, relaxed graphite cargo trousers with bold pockets and a dangling utility strap, chunky cobalt/ivory sneakers, one short silver chain. No military gear. Pose: confident asymmetrical standing stance, weight on the back leg, one foot forward with a slightly low-angle street-fashion perspective; left hand deep in trouser pocket, right hand casually nudging the corner of the rectangular glasses. Slight knowing half-smile, chin tipped down, gaze toward viewer. Tail curves as a graphic counterbalance. Design the garment silhouette with broad strong stencil shapes. Minimal electric blue offset shadow.

variants.title: 02 · 滑板少年
variants.style: Outfit: oversized cobalt-blue zip hoodie worn open over a charcoal graphic-free tee, loose faded-black wide-leg denim with rolled cuffs, off-white skate shoes with acid-yellow panels, a thin red wristband and a compact cross-body pouch. Both ears and glasses fully unobscured. Pose: deep relaxed skater crouch on a stationary skateboard, one sneaker planted on the board deck and the other on the ground, knees bent visibly, one forearm resting on a raised knee, other hand loosely reaching down to hold the front of the skateboard. Strong diagonal composition, three-quarter view, self-assured small grin. The skateboard is a clearly recognizable simple unbranded deck with four wheels and a cobalt/acid-yellow underside. Tail swings upward behind to balance the composition. No motion blur, no action explosion, no extra scene.

variants.title: 03 · 涂鸦创作者
variants.style: Outfit: oversized charcoal hooded windbreaker with acid-yellow lining and cobalt shoulder panels, boxy ivory T-shirt, sand-colored baggy carpenter pants with a few small blue paint marks, black high-top sneakers with off-white soles, fingerless work gloves. No formal blazer or plaid. Pose: low one-knee kneel in profile, torso turning back toward viewer, right hand confidently holding a small spray-paint can forward and slightly upward; left hand resting on the raised knee. Relaxed focused expression with a slight mischievous smile, ears alert. A SHORT electric-blue spray plume makes one bold abstract diagonal stencil stroke immediately beside the character, with a small acid-yellow offset accent. No wall or large setting, no words or graffiti lettering; just the character, can, and compact paint stroke. Tail curves naturally away from the paint, full sneakers and tail visible.
